paragraphs.text: Alchemy: Ixalan is a MTG Arena -exclusive card set in the Alchemy -series that was released on December 5, 2023.

Alchemy: Ixalan is a digital only release adjacent to the release of The Lost Caverns of Ixalan . There are 30 new designed-for-digital cards included in the set (10 uncommons, 15 rares, 5 mythic rares) . All of the cards are set on Ixalan .

The digital-only mechanics Conjure , Double team , Intensity , One-time boon , Perpetually , Seek and Spellbook are reused. From the main set, Discover , Explore , Descend 8 , Fathomless descent and Map tokens are reused. Enrage returns from the original Ixalan set.
The action of perpetually increasing a card's intensity number is keyworded as Intensify .

The set introduces the Chorus subtype for Instant and Sorcery spells to represent songs and sea shanties . The subtype itself has no function beyond flavor but it allows for the Intensity mechanic to affect multiple cards without having to name them. The set includes the first multiple-use Three-time boon .
